narrative:
## Board Submission Narrative — FY2026 Cost-to-Income Plan

The FY2026 plan was built through a 6-phase connected planning process across Group Finance, Treasury, Wealth & Life, Operations and Data & Change.

## Headline
• Operating income EUR 336M (+5.7%), operating expenses EUR 196M (+1.0%)
• Cost-to-income 58.3% (FY2025: 61.0%) — target <60% met
• ROE 12.4% — target >12% met

## Risk Factors
• Rates: -25bp Euribor ≈ +1.2pp C/I — mitigated by hedging and deposit pricing
• Fee yield compression — mitigated by volume growth and wealth bundling
• Core banking delivery — re-phased, go-live unchanged

## AI/ML Governance
• 3 AI agents produced 15 proposals across 5 phases
• Plan built on Aktia DW actuals in Snowflake — single version of the truth

signals.title: Aktia Strategy 2026 — Efficiency & Wealth Growth
signals.excerpt: Board reconfirms financial targets: cost-to-income below 60% and ROE above 12%. Growth priority is wealth management; banking services to be developed through digital channels.

signals.title: ECB Easing Path — Deposit Rate at 2.00%
signals.excerpt: Markets price a flat deposit rate through 2026. 12M Euribor stabilised near 2.1%, ending the NII tailwind that lifted Finnish banks in 2023-24.
